issues.location: target paragraph linking A.I. cold call agents
issues.problem: “冷呼叫智能体”略显机械，像从 English technical phrase 直译过来。中文读者更自然的说法可能是“冷拨电话智能体”或“电话推销 A.I. 智能体”。
issues.suggestion: Consider revising to a more idiomatic Chinese technical phrase if polishing manually.

issues.location: feature bullet “Up-to-date code libraries with access to the internet”
issues.problem: “联网获取最新代码库” can be read as repositories rather than libraries/packages. Meaning is still understandable, but technical precision could be tighter.
issues.suggestion: Consider “联网获取最新代码库/依赖库信息” or “联网获取最新库文档” depending on intended meaning.

reviews.notes: The translation preserves Ernie’s informal, blunt, playful technical-personal voice and reads as natural Mandarin rather than sentence-by-sentence English-shaped Chinese. Human-facing caption, iframe alt text, link text, and publication note are translated; product names, A.I. spelling, code-adjacent terms, and MDX structure are preserved. Frontmatter serialization changes and translationStatus are not treated as quality issues.

issues.location: feature bullet: “Up-to-date code libraries with access to the internet”
issues.problem: “联网获取最新代码库”略容易和上一条“代码库索引”混在一起；这里的 libraries 更像库/框架资料或依赖文档，不一定是 repository/codebase。
issues.suggestion: 可改为“联网访问最新的库和框架资料”或“联网获取最新的代码库/依赖资料”。

reviews.notes: 整体是自然的中文技术随笔语气，保留了作者口语化、吐槽式节奏和 A.I./Cursor/ReAct 等术语，没有明显按英文句序硬译；MDX、链接、iframe 属性和 frontmatter 语义均未见破坏。
